utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Ira, are we still on for the repair drive today? If so, what time should I show up?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep, we’re still on — could you come by around 2? That should give us enough time to load up before we head out.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good — I’ll be there around 2. Do you want me to bring any tools or supplies?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Noah — I’ve got a few tools I can lend for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks Gus — I might need a hammer and a screwdriver. I’ll swing by when I can.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ll set aside a hammer and a screwdriver for you. Just stop by whenever you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a nice turnout already. If you want, I can pass along the details I’ve heard so far.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would help, thanks — I’m just trying to figure out the timing and where to drop things off.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure — I’ve heard it’s set for Saturday morning at the community hall, and they’re taking donations right by the side entrance.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam — could you swing by the community center to pick up the donation boxes, then drop them at the repair shed on Pine Street?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can do that. I’ll pick up the donation boxes at the community center and drop them off at the repair shed on Pine Street.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Uli, I’m spreading the word about the repair drive—want me to put your name down or bring you the details?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. Could you bring me the details? I’m not sure yet, but I’d like to see what it’s about.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll bring you the details and keep you posted. If it looks like a fit, I can add your name later.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo — I’m putting the repair drive pieces in order now. Let me know what you can help with, and I’ll slot it in.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help sort the donations and carry boxes.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be a huge help, Leo — thank you. I’ll put you on sorting and box-carrying when folks start arriving.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m ready to help—what details do we need to check for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I usually join a bit late, but I can check the sign-up list and see what tools we still need.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That’d help a lot—could you also note who’s already signed up and whether we still need any gloves or screwdrivers?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help line things up around the school schedule. What do you need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be a huge help, Faye—thank you. We’re still gathering tools and volunteers, so if you can share the school times, I’ll fit the repair drive around them.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely — I’ll send over the school times and any tricky windows I know about. Then we can pick a repair drive slot that won’t clash with pickup or events.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces about the repair drive—what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s coming along nicely—people are still signing up, and we’re trying to match folks with the right jobs. If you’ve heard of anyone who wants to help, I’d be happy to loop them in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds great—I'll pass it along if I hear anyone. What kind of help are you still looking for?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just confirm you’re still good to help with the repair drive, and I’ll take it from there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’m still good to help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help where I can—what part of the repair drive needs the most attention?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—thanks, Rey. I think the biggest need is sorting the donated tools and seeing what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can take a look at the tools and sort them into what’s usable and what’s still needed. If you want, I can also jot down the missing items as I go.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m in for the repair drive, and I’ll let a few neighbors know the plan too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’s great, Vik — thank you. I’ll keep track of the supplies and let you know what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll spread the word and check back with you later. Thanks for keeping track of the supplies.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds like a good thing to support — I can swing by the repair drive and spread the word while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira — I really appreciate that. It’ll help a lot if you can spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — I’ll mention it to folks while I’m running errands today. Hope you get a great turnout!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I’m in if you still need a hand. Just remind me what time we’re meeting, and I’ll do my best not to forget this time.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Oren — we’re meeting at 10 in the community shed. I’ll remind you again before then so you don’t miss it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik — 10 at the community shed, got it. I’ll be there, and I’ll appreciate that reminder so I don’t wander off and forget.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. What was changing again?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just the small stuff first—lamps, tools, and any appliances that still have some life left.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, got it — lamps, tools, and appliances that still work a bit. I can bring whatever I find around here.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand if you need any tools for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’d be appreciated, Gus. I’m keeping it simple—let’s make a clear list of what we need and I’ll stop by at the usual time.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Eli — I’ll jot down a simple tool list and have it ready for you at the usual time.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to take on?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with whatever’s most useful—signups, supplies, or spreading the word. What should I take first?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help connect folks for the repair drive—what do you need me to pass along?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — please pass along that I’m looking for anyone who can help with appliance and bike repairs, and that I’m near Maple and 3rd.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word that you need help with appliance and bike repairs, and that you’re near Maple and 3rd.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Got it — 9 a.m., and I’ll bring whatever tools and supplies I have on hand.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, Rosa — thank you. I’ll keep track of what’s still needed and let you know if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sounds good, Cleo — I’ll be ready at 9 and happy to help wherever I’m needed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: We’re still collecting tool donations and a few volunteers for Saturday. Do you want me to put your name down?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, please put my name down—I can help if you still need someone on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Could you help sort donations and hand out flyers after school? That’d make a big difference.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can sort donations and hand out flyers after school.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm you’ll be there on Saturday to help load the donations?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I’ll be there Saturday to help load the donations.
